WreckItRalph_Vanellope/Vanellope_CrossNP.en: What's in these pancakes?! LAVA?! Hoo, hoo, hoo! TOO HOT!
My mouth is on FIRE! And this SOUR LEMONADE is making it WORSE!
Ralph, are you hiding over there behind that obviously cardboard bush?!

WreckItRalph_Vanellope/Vanellope_SEC_For.en: Ta-da! One super special <ActivityItem>cookie</ActivityItem> for my hero and best buddy in the whole wide world!
I... I STILL can't move. Why can't I move?! Help!
Wh-what? This isn't funny anymore! Friendship's always supposed to win...
What else can we try?
Take a deep breath. We'll think of something!
At least Ralph makes a cool statue?
Ralph, I'm SO sorry! You went to find me. This is my fault!
It's not your fault, Vanellope...
It's mine.
A long time ago, Ralph tried to convince me I was good deep down. I used dark magic to banish him.
Is THAT why you've been weird this whole time?
He wanted to help you and you sent him away?
Dark banishment?! That's hardcore.
I've been so afraid that if Ralph saw me again, he would remember what I did.
He'd never forgive me.
I remember it now. You were just a scared kid...
Of course I forgive you.
Wh— what?
You made a mistake. I make 'em all the time. I forgive you, I promise.
This is so sweet.
I'm crying!!!
This is SO sappy and Ralph is still stuck.
I... thank you.
I never forgot you, Ralph. That's why I kept this <ActivityItem>Arcade Token</ActivityItem> all these years.
A token! THAT'S IT! {PlayerName}, put it in the machine!
Way to step on the moment, {PlayerName}.
I'm not proud of it.
Oh hey, chums! Is this weird <ActivityItem>Fix-It Felix Jr. Arcade Cabinet</ActivityItem> either of yours?
It JUST popped up in my House outta nowhere. Pretty weird, huh?
We've been chasing it around the Valley.
Any idea how to fix it?
I knew this chaos was linked to you!
How do you chase a machine? Ya know what? Never mind. Not a mission-critical problem.
What have you tried to do to get this thing working?
It's been glitching around the Valley, so...
We fed it root beer and pie?
We gave it piles of bricks?
Doesn't matter; nothing has worked so far.
Root beer and pie...? WAIT! My best friend Ralph LOVES those!
Hmph. Maybe we should leave it alone. Seems like a lost cause.
Give up now? No way! The machine isn't ON, but we don't know if it's <Lore>broken</Lore>.
Have you tried <Lore>giving it a little bop</Lore>? Mr. Litwak used to do that to the older machines in the arcade.
Worked like a charm almost every time!
Huh... OH! My best friend Ralph used to live in a pile of bricks!
Really? Sheesh!
I'm gonna choose to take that as a compliment.
